reviews.title: It’s good but needs work
reviews.text: I have limited equipment (free weights and a squat rack with a pulley). Almost all the leg day exercises rely on expensive machines. If you swap exercises, you’re only left with squats or goblet squats. So essentially leg day is  19 sets of squats 😂 Also when you swap certain things that are labeled as “♾️” and you swap them because u don’t have that machine, the reps and tempo will stay at infinity  I swapped leg raises with ab crunches and it did this. Not sure if that’s by design. Finally when you swap out an exercise with something else it only gives you three ish options. Then suggests “similar exercises” which are not even the same muscle group. It always starts with -35 degree neutral grip something. It looks like it’s just abc order. It would be better if it listed the similar exercises based on the closest muscle groups to be worked that are actually similar.  Also when you extract the data of the workouts it would be helpful if it broke it down into a excel or spreadsheet or some other infographic that shows the reps, sets, weights and notes so I can analyze and compare. I usually plug em into an ai to give me more data. The way it outputs rn looks cool for an ig post but not really helpful for comparing and analyzing individual sets week to week. The food logging is nice. I wish it had more stats like the other nutrition app everyone uses such as weekly food intake broken down by macros, calories, averages etc.  Not sure if this isn’t there because I’m on my first week (free trail period) and the data isn’t there yet or not. The only options I have are to see that I logged food for that calendar day. That’s it. Anyway, not sure if I continue the app or just stick to iNotes logs and the other macro pal app.

reviews.title: Paid annually now locked out for three weeks. Not at all close to resolved.
reviews.text:
I paid $119.99 for an annual membership and had an established account containing my workout history and roughly 7,000 points. Since September 1, every attempt to access it on my new phone has either routed me through new-user onboarding or taken me to a checkout page asking me to select another plan.

Over approximately 20 messages, I have supplied screenshots, corrected an early email-address typo, reset my password, and tried the direct links, Safari, Chrome, and the application itself. Support continues sending the same login and password-reset instructions instead of repairing the connection to my existing paid account.

I was told the problem was escalated to engineering and management, but I have received no technical resolution or substantive update. I still cannot access my program or meal plan, and my request for reimbursement for the unusable portion of my subscription has not been addressed. The content was useful when accessible, but this level of paid-service failure and support justifies one star until it is resolved.

Office ours are Mon-Fri 9-5 CST well that’s the time zone I live in. 9:30am I got an email asking what the problem was. At 9:40am I gave the info and asked how can we resolve this because i don’t wanna commit to the app for a whole year.
